description: Target stylometric profiles for human-like academic writing. Used by the plagbypass skill to calibrate humanization transforms.

perplexity_targets.note: PPL measured against GPT-2 base. Higher = less predictable = more human.

burstiness_targets.note: Standard deviation of per-sentence PPL. Higher = more rhythm variation.

sentence_length_distribution.note: Human writing has ~15% short bursts. AI tends toward 90%+ medium.

paragraph_structure.ideal_variation: Alternate between 2-3 sentence and 5-6 sentence paragraphs.
paragraph_structure.interpretive_paragraphs: Insert a 1-2 sentence interpretive paragraph every 3-4 analytical paragraphs.

voice_markers.first_person_frequency: 1-2 per 500 words (We observed, Our analysis, We propose)
voice_markers.hedging_frequency: 1 per 200 words (appears to, seems, may, could, potentially)
voice_markers.interpretive_frequency: 1 per 300 words (Interestingly, Remarkably, This suggests, One explanation is)
voice_markers.rhetorical_questions: 1 per 1000 words (Why does this pattern emerge? What accounts for...?)

lexical_diversity.note: Never reuse the same transition word within 500 words.
lexical_diversity.opener_rotation: Use each type at least once per 1000 words.

avoid: Overly casual language (stuff, things, a lot)
encourage: Comparison with prior work using contrastive language
Domain-specific jargon used precisely (not for decoration)
